attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican party is determined to change federal law to give small employers the liberty to band together to purchase group insurance for their employees at reduced rates.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"With a Republican president, the expansion of coverage for small employers will no longer be blocked by veto threats.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"27 million individuals and families will be enabled to purchase private health insurance through a proposed tax credit.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Health insurance premiums will be fully deductible for the self-employed, according to the proposal.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Uninsured Americans have varying situations related to family status, age, and income.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"It makes sense to let uninsured Americans decide what kind of coverage best suits their needs.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
